headline: Bitcoin jumped above $64,000 on Monday as stocks soared on Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, then gave most of it back to about $61,400, while money kept leaving bitcoin funds ahead of a likely December Fed rate hike.

market.asOf: CoinMarketCap pages read about 20:00 UTC Mon 23 Nov (3:00pm ET, 03:00 Tue Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 11 out of 100 ("Extreme Fear") on the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index for 23 Nov, as shown by cryptonro.com; CoinStats' separate index was 9 ("Extreme Fear").

stories.title: Bitcoin spikes above $64,000 on Nvidia's CEO news, then gives most of it back
stories.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and US stocks had a huge day. Bitcoin rode the rally up but could not hold it: by the US afternoon it was back near where the day started. Traders said the jump was mostly short sellers being forced out, not new buyers.
points: Bitcoin hit $64,505 on Bitstamp, more than 17% above Saturday's 26-month low, per Cointelegraph.
By 18:38 UTC it was about $61,429 on Binance, only 0.26% above the day's open, per crypto.news.
More than $500 million of crypto bets were liquidated in the four hours before 16:00 UTC, per Cointelegraph citing CoinGlass.
Nvidia shares were up 30.6% at 1:57pm ET and the Nasdaq was up 6.5% during the session, per Beinsure; these are not closing prices.
Sentiment is still at "Extreme Fear": 11 on the alternative.me index.

sources.label: Cointelegraph: bitcoin rebounds as Nvidia rally sparks $500M liquidations
The Block: crypto and tech stocks rally as Nvidia reinstates Huang

stories.title: Money keeps leaving bitcoin funds, and traders still expect a December Fed hike
stories.summary: Under Monday's bounce the backdrop is still tough. US spot bitcoin funds lost money again last week, and futures traders put the odds of a Fed rate hike in December above 90%. October PCE inflation on Wednesday could move those odds.
points: US spot bitcoin funds lost $1.79 billion in the week to 20 Nov, their third-largest weekly outflow, per Cointelegraph.
On Fri 20 Nov alone they lost $669.2 million, $544.7 million of it from BlackRock's IBIT, per crypto.news citing Farside.
CME FedWatch had a quarter-point December hike at 93.2%, per KuCoin.
Traders have dropped bets on a half-point hike, per CoinDesk.
US stock markets and the spot crypto funds are closed Thursday 26 Nov for Thanksgiving; crypto itself keeps trading.

sources.label: Cointelegraph: bitcoin ETFs' third-largest weekly outflow

stories.title: New York judge declines to shut down Kalshi for now
stories.summary: A New York state judge refused the Attorney General's request for a temporary restraining order against the prediction market Kalshi. Kalshi keeps operating while the full case is argued, and the fight is heading into January.
points: Justice Melissa Crane denied the order on Mon 23 Nov: "I'm not seeing the factors I need to issue an injunction on this very preliminary basis," per Sports Betting Dime.

Lawyers return on Mon 30 Nov to report on safeguards for young users (18-to-20-year-olds per Sports Betting Dime, 18-to-21 per CoinDesk), and a fuller hearing was offered for 7 or 8 Jan 2027, per Sports Betting Dime.
Kalshi must also answer New Jersey on a Supreme Court question by 7 Dec, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: US moves to seize about $1 billion in USDC tied to the Binance hack
briefs.summary: The Justice Department filed a civil forfeiture complaint on 23 Nov covering 36 addresses on 18 blockchains; Circle had already frozen the funds, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Monad's large MON unlock is Tuesday
briefs.summary: About 16.6 billion MON unlock on 24 Nov, mostly to the team and investors, per Coinranking. See the unlock table on this page for this desk's size and confidence.

briefs.title: OKX and ICE launch a tokenized stock venue
briefs.summary: OKXICE went live with 113 assets for round-the-clock trading; 67 companies, including Apple, Microsoft and Nvidia, objected to having their shares listed, per The Block.

briefs.title: ARK withdraws two crypto index ETF filings
briefs.summary: ARK asked the SEC on 20 Nov to withdraw its CoinDesk 20 ETF filings, saying it "does not intend to proceed", per AltcoinBuzz.

briefs.title: VanEck drops Gemini as a custodian for three crypto ETFs
briefs.summary: The change for HODL, ETHV and VSOL takes effect around 16 Feb 2027; Coinbase Custody stays on, per Coinpaprika.

briefs.title: Chainflip's bounty deadline has passed
briefs.summary: Chainflip offered the hacker a 10% bounty to return the rest of about $12 million stolen, with a deadline of 18:38 UTC Mon 23 Nov, per Cryptonomist.

briefs.title: Wallet user reports a $613,000 theft
briefs.summary: A Trezor and Exodus user lost about $613,000, mostly USDT on TRON, from wallets used on the same iPhone; how the thief got access is unknown, per crypto.news.

calendar.event: New York Fed President John Williams speaks
calendar.note: Remarks on the economic outlook and policy, then Q&A, per the New York Fed. Zoom and HPE report earnings after the close, per TipRanks.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), Q3 GDP (second estimate), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: Core PCE expected at 3.4% a year (September 3.1%) and headline at 3.8% (September 3.6%), per the consensus in a Goldman/Deutsche Bank week-ahead preview. Q3 GDP expected at 3.5% per FXEmpire, 3.4% per CoinDesk. Jobless claims expected at 200K (prior 203K). Release time per the BEA schedule.
NYSE is closed Thursday and closes early at 1:00pm ET on Friday 27 Nov (01:00 Sat Bangkok), per NYSE's holiday calendar. Crypto trades through the holiday.

calendar.note: Decision Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu Bangkok), per the Federal Reserve's calendar. Odds of a quarter-point hike: 93.2% per KuCoin citing CME FedWatch.
